name: febris-simulation-sdk
description: On-device xAPI statement builder for simulations and games. Prebuilt native SDK with a flat C ABI (FebrisSimApi.h): builds and updates xAPI 1.0.3 statements in-process, no HTTP client and no database, and hands the finished statement to the host application. Byte-parity locked to the C# Febris.Simulation.XApiSdk package.
